text:
maya: FYI we've got a handful of customer sessions where SSE clients never finish after a resume. They stay open, no new tokens, but billing shows resumed tokens charged twice.
ken: repro steps? can you paste the raw headers/trace?
maya: minimal repro: client disconnects, then sends Resume-Token header, proxy logs show a late ACK ~3s after resume, then the origin starts streaming duplicate token charges. snippet: ```proxy: recv resume token=abc123 ts=1769501229
proxy: forward resume to service ts=1769501230
service: resume accepted ts=1769501221 ack_id=0x7f
proxy: ack from service delayed ts=1769501224```. odd timing.
priya: is the billing emitted on resume acceptance or on first chunk? console shows billing counter increments at resume API call time.
zach: we key billing off resume.accept event in the control plane today (racey). that explains dup charges when proxies replay resume after connection hiccup.
li: telemetry shows resume_replays and resume_attempts spikes for that tenant, plus conn.sticky_lease often toggles in same window. suspect proxy circuit retries + client reconnect jitter.
ken: proposal: make resume idempotent with a resume-id and server-side dedupe window. also debounce proxy replays for the same resume-id for 1s. that would avoid double-billing if ack arrives late.
maya: agreed but this is cross-layer: runtime has to accept idempotent resume tokens, billing needs to only record first accepted resume, and proxy needs backoff.
priya: UI/console UX: customers will see two token charges in the breakdown today. we should add a transient "duplicate resume reconciliation" flag in console so support can explain it before we roll fix.
infra-bot: deploy-status: rollout canary: eng-runtime/resume-idempotency v1 -> 10% eu-west-1 at 1769501350.
zach: quick implementation detail: add resume_id header from client (UUID). runtime stores last_resume_id per session with TTL 60s. if same resume_id observed, drop extra billing emit.
li: storing per-session state is fine for dedicated pools but problematic for ephemeral multi-tenant hosts. alternative: encode resume_id in the resume ack token and have billing emitted only when ack token is confirmed.
ken: that moves billing responsibility to origin ack path which we already instrument; downside is a small latency before token-charges appear in console (~200-500ms). ops ok with that?
priya: acceptable if we mark charges as "pending" in console until confirmed. reduces customer confusion.
maya: also need proxy change: stop optimistic replay of resume when connection flips within 500ms; add a jittered backoff to avoid thundering resumes.
zach: can we fold this into the streaming rollout? small canary first, then broaden. Add telemetry counters: resume_id_received, resume_deduped, resume_billed_on_ack.
li: I'll add metrics and alert (SLO: resume_dedup_rate < 0.1% per hour).
ken: question for product: do we want an API break to require resume-id from SDKs?
priya: prefer a graceful opt-in: SDKs start sending resume-id, server accepts if present; legacy resumes still work but treated best-effort. document the change in SDK release notes and console.
maya: next actions: (1) zach implement idempotency + billing-on-ack PR, (2) ken add proxy debounce and jitter, (3) li add metrics and alert, (4) priya update console UI to show pending/resolved charges. target next-week canary.
infra-bot: ticket created: RT-4123 "SSE resume double-billing + hanging sessions" assigned to @zach @ken @li @priya, priority P1.
maya: thanks — ping me if you need traces or a sample tenant to test.
ken: I'll post a test script here later: simple curl-based SSE resume with injected delay on ACK.
priya: also create a short console banner for affected customers while we roll. :warning:
li: noted, will add banner template.
maya: small note — this repro was concentrated on clients using sticky routing through an opaque proxy. if anyone digging into routing policy, the proxy was switching target pool mid-resume in ~0.5% of cases. that likely worsened late-ack.
zach: good catch. ensure resume_id is scoped to the logical session id, not physical backend.
ken: ok. will coordinate with eng-platform on sticky routing heuristics after we have idempotency in place.
priya: thanks all, moving to tracking board.
